title: Sar Ka Paw Battalion Rejoins KNLA Brigade 4 With 50-Plus Fighters
detail: The Sar Ka Paw Battalion, previously expelled from the Karen National Liberation Army-affiliated KTLA, formally rejoined KNLA Brigade 4 on September 21, 2026, bringing more than 50 fighters back into the Karen National Union's command structure.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Sar Ka Paw Battalion's reintegration into KNLA Brigade 4.
